question: To enhance the interoperability between the Indian and Russian Armies, a joint training exercise called _________ commenced at Prudboy Ranges, Volgograd in the year 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**INDRA 2021**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A joint training exercise named **INDRA 2021** was initiated to enhance interoperability between the Indian and Russian Armies.
 
• This exercise commenced at Prudboy Ranges, Volgograd in the year 2021.
 
• **INDRA** series of exercises are conducted annually and focus on counter-terrorism operations and strengthening military cooperation between India and Russia.
 
• It provides a platform for both armies to share best practices and experiences in various combat situations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **INDRA** exercises were first held in the year 2003.
 
• These exercises are part of the ongoing defense cooperation between India and Russia, which includes joint military programs, defense procurement, and other forms of military engagement.
 
• India and Russia share a long-standing defense relationship, with Russia being one of the largest suppliers of defense equipment to India.
 
• The exercises typically involve complex drills and operations, including live-fire exercises, tactical maneuvers, and counter-terrorism operations.
